equipment_type: Heating controller (boiler, district heating, domestic hot water)
applies_to: Regin Exigo 4.3 heating controllers: up to 4 heating circuits, 2 hot-water circuits, boilers, district heating, solar and buffer tanks.
summary: Exigo 4.3 is Regin's pre-programmed controller for heating plants. Its EDE file lists 623 objects: mode switch and manual/auto selectors for circuits, pumps and boilers, room and supply setpoints per heating circuit (HS1-HS4), hot-water (HW1/HW2) and boiler values, outdoor temperatures, M-bus meter values, individual alarm BVs, schedules and calendars.
notes: Temperature and pressure objects marked "(configurable)" in the EDE take the unit set in the controller (for example °C or °F), so no unit is given for them.
Objects for circuits, boilers and meters that are not configured stay unused.
Object names with (0) in them are printed that way in the EDE.
There is no single sum-alarm object; alarms are individual BVs (AlaPt(n)) plus three notification classes.
The EDE file does not say which BACnet data link (BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP) the controller uses; check the model data sheet.

integration.summary: Use MV 30002 ModeSwitch for the plant mode (off, auto, summer, holiday, continuous) and MV 31390 HS1_Select for heating circuit 1. Read AV 40001 outdoor temperature, AV 40026 / AV 40032 HS1 supply temperature and calculated setpoint, AV 40027 room temperature, BV 20004 pump status and the deviation alarms. BV 10014 acknowledges all alarms.
integration.enable: MV 30002 ModeSwitch sets the overall mode; each circuit also has a Manual/Auto selector (for example MV 31390 HS1_Select) that must be on Auto for normal control.
gotchas: Setpoints and configuration values are stored in the controller; do not write them cyclically.
